column_description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each vehicle record (format: EVxxxxxx).
Commercial model brand and code designation (e.g., Drift-268, Orion-619).
Automotive Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) brand name (200 unique brands).
Production model release year (ranging from 2018 to 2026).
Country of primary vehicle assembly/manufacturing (10 global manufacturing hubs).

sample_or_range: South Asia, Middle East, North America
column_description: Primary commercial sales region / geographic target market (7 continental regions).
Vehicle body style and operational classification (15 distinct market segments).
Total nominal electrical energy storage capacity of the battery pack in kilowatt-hours (kWh).
Electrochemical cell chemistry formulation (NMC, LFP, NCA, Sodium-Ion, Solid-State).
Rated standard charge-discharge cycle durability before reaching 80% state of health.
Projected cumulative battery capacity degradation percentage over 5 years of usage.
Certified single-charge maximum driving distance in kilometers (WLTP/EPA equivalent).
Average electrical energy consumption rate in Watt-hours per kilometer (Wh/km).
Total rated maximum electrical powertrain power output in kilowatts (kW).
Total peak powertrain rotational torque output in Newton-meters (Nm).
Number of physical electric traction motors installed (1, 2, or 3 motors).
Powertrain drive wheel configuration (FWD: Front-Wheel, RWD: Rear-Wheel, AWD: All-Wheel).
Maximum electronically governed or rated vehicle top speed in kilometers per hour (km/h).
Time elapsed in seconds to accelerate from stationary (0 km/h) to 100 km/h.
Peak Direct Current (DC) fast-charging input power acceptance limit in kilowatts (kW).
Average DC fast-charging duration in minutes to replenish battery from 20% to 80% SoC.
Duration in hours required for a complete 0-100% recharge using standard AC Level 2 charger.
Number of physical external vehicle charging inlet ports (1 or 2).
Total certified passenger and driver seating capacity (1 to 65 seats).
Total unladen curb weight of the vehicle in kilograms (kg).
Total enclosed boot / cargo storage luggage capacity in liters.
Manufacturer Recommended Retail Price (MSRP) base price in United States Dollars (USD).
Estimated annual comprehensive automotive insurance premium in United States Dollars (USD).
Manufacturer powertrain and battery bumper-to-bumper warranty duration in years.
Projected retained market valuation percentage after 3 years of vehicle ownership.
Standard crash test and active occupant safety rating (1 to 5 stars).
Standard SAE automated driving capability level (Level 0 through Level 5).
Diagonal physical screen size of primary dashboard infotainment display in inches.
Estimated net annual metric tons of CO2 greenhouse gas emissions saved versus equivalent ICE vehicle.
Recorded global annual unit sales volume for the specified model in units sold.
Aggregated verified owner satisfaction and product review score on a 1.0 to 5.0 scale.

sample_or_range: Family Daily Use, Urban Commute, Highway / Long-Distance
column_description: Recommended operational usage profile (e.g., Urban Commute, Family Daily Use).
